datasheet_identity.title: MM1Z2V0B THRU MM1Z75B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: MM1Z30B table row gives VZ min/nom/max = 29.4/30.0/30.6 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT = 80 ohm at IZT; IR = 0.1 uA at VR = 23 V (p. 2).

The p. 3 zener-characteristics plots label curves for 10B, 12B, 15B, 18B, 20B, 22B, 27B and 33B; no MM1Z30B-specific trace is labeled or separable. Curves are therefore omitted rather than borrowing the neighboring 27B or 33B trace.
No per-part capacitance or reverse-recovery time is published.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable MM1Z30B-specific curve is published: the p. 3 family zener plots label 27B and 33B traces but not 30B, so adjacent-part curves cannot be assigned to MM1Z30B without inventing evidence.
